title: Finow and nightscout
body: My Finow Q1 Pro smartwatch does not send data to mongodb. Everything on the phone is working. Did anyone have a similar problem.

comments.body: I could try to help but I would need more information. Do you have correctly installed Heroku? I assume the watch is the collector and sends it over to nightscout with the usual address which includes you API_SECRET?

Works well for me.
Are you using rest or direct mongo upload?
